claim: Operating an ST25 sliding door adds 1024 to its SE15 effector's angle before the first move, so the door first travels opposite to the effector's authored angle.
use: Slide a converted SE15 along its angle plus 1024 on the first operation.

checked.how: Read reference/eduke32/source/duke3d/src/sector.cpp:1006-1024 (G_OperateSectors, case ST_25_SLIDING_DOOR): finds the SE15 in the sector, then for every SE15 with its hitag toggles lotag 0x8000 and at :1021 SA(i) += 1024. actors.cpp:7609-7637 (SE_15 in the effector loop) moves by A_MoveSector, which steps along pSprite->ang (:966-967). bloodmap/duke_motion.py:183-184 angle + 1024.
